name: bada-serenace
description: Bada Serenace — a disease-prevention-mechanism simulator. From the true inverse of building blocks (reading a generating word back out of an invariant), through the Gamma global integration-by-parts manifold used as a thermal-sensing conduction kernel and the Jones polynomial computed by a Kauffman state sum, to constructible RNA interference and a receptor-occupancy model of Serenace (haloperidol). Conceptual simulation, not medical software.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
